items.content_html: Google SecOpsFeatureBasic Mode searchThis feature is in public preview. The SIEM Search page now provides two search-execution modes: Basic Mode and Advanced Mode. Basic Mode (the default option) uses a streamlined, fast-path execution pipeline that bypasses secondary enrichment steps during search execution.
